verdict.rationale: Paged attention KV-cache management is a fair question for an LLM inference runtime like LocalAI, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers API compatibility, MCP, agents, GPU auto-detection and distributed nodes, but never mentions paged or block-based KV-cache memory management, fragmentation avoidance, or concurrent-request capacity.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on paged memory management for attention key/value cache to maximize concurrent request capacity without memory fragmentation
